exercises.explanationUz:
BU NIMA?
Har to'rt unitdan keyin MODUL TESTI keladi. U unit emas —
o'zingizni sinash uchun test.

BALLAR TAQSIMOTI (jami 100):
  1-mashq  — mamlakat va millat        10 ball
  2-mashq  — so'z qo'yish              10 ball
  3-mashq  — to'g'ri variantni tanlash 10 ball
  4-mashq  — predloglar                 8 ball
  5-mashq  — fe'l shakllari             8 ball
  6-mashq  — olmoshlar                  6 ball
  7-mashq  — egalik ('s / s')           5 ball
  8-mashq  — savol-javob moslash        7 ball
  9-mashq  — o'qish va savollar        10 ball
  10-mashq — ortiqcha so'zni topish     8 ball
  11-mashq — odam tavsifi yozish       18 ball

QANDAY ISHLATISH:
  1) Avval hech narsaga qaramasdan bajaring
  2) Keyin javoblarni tekshiring
  3) Xato qilgan mavzuni O'SHA unitdan qaytadan ko'ring

tasks.en: Module Self-Assessment 1 (Units 1 - 4)
TOTAL: 100 marks

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct country or nationality. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri mamlakat yoki millat nomini yozing. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAMLAKAT ↔ MILLAT (Unit 1 mavzusi).

MILLAT QO'SHIMCHALARI:
  -an / -ian:  Argentina → Argentinian, Mexico → Mexican,
               Brazil → Brazilian, Canada → Canadian
  -ish:        Spain → Spanish, Turkey → Turkish,
               Finland → Finnish, Scotland → Scottish
  -ese:        Japan → Japanese, China → Chinese
  -k / boshqa: Greece → Greek

DIQQAT: millat nomi HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi —
o'zbek tilida bunday qoida yo'q!
  ✅ He is Spanish.   ❌ He is spanish.

tasks.whyUz: Argentina + -ian. Janubiy Amerika mamlakati.
Brazilian dan orqaga: Brazil (Braziliya).
Spain + -ish. Til nomi ham 'Spanish'.
Mexico + -an, 'o' tushadi.
Greek dan orqaga: Greece (Yunoniston). Millat 'Greek' — noodatiy shakl.
Finnish dan orqaga: Finland (Finlandiya). 'Finland' → 'Finnish' — 'land' tushadi.
Turkey + -ish, 'ey' tushadi. DIQQAT: 'turkey' kichik harf bilan — kurka (parranda).
Canadian dan orqaga: Canada (Kanada).
Japan + -ese. Til nomi ham 'Japanese'.
Scottish dan orqaga: Scotland (Shotlandiya). Odam esa 'a Scot'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI:
  hear, near, going, College, dancer, spacious,
  cheap, e-mail, yellowish, view

Har bir so'z FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Gapning ma'nosiga va grammatikasiga qarang:
  • 'a ____ living-room' — sifat kerak
  • 'loves ____ to the cinema' — -ing shakli kerak
  • 'She is a ____' — ot kerak

tasks.whyUz: Otdan oldin SIFAT kerak. spacious = keng (Unit 3).
'love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi (Unit 4).
'e-mail pal' — elektron pochta orqali yozishadigan do'st. 'pen pal' ning zamonaviy varianti.
'hear from somebody' = kimdandir xabar olmoq. Xat oxiridagi standart ibora.

tasks.prompt: 5  Rashid is a student at Mortimer ____ .
tasks.whyUz: O'quv yurti nomi — katta harf bilan. 'at ... College' — muassasada.
tasks.speak: 5  Rashid is a student at Mortimer ____ .

tasks.prompt: 6  Bob's house is ____ the city centre.
tasks.whyUz: 'near' = yaqin. Predlogsiz ishlatiladi ('near from' XATO).
tasks.speak: 6  Bob's house is ____ the city centre.

tasks.prompt: 7  We have got a wonderful ____ from our balcony.
tasks.whyUz: 'a wonderful view' — ajoyib manzara (Unit 3).
tasks.speak: 7  We have got a wonderful ____ from our balcony.

tasks.prompt: 8  This modern flat is a bargain. It's really very ____ .
tasks.whyUz: 'bargain' = arzon taklif → demak narxi arzon (cheap).
tasks.speak: 8  This modern flat is a bargain. It's really very ____ .

tasks.prompt: 9  Mary is quite tall and slim. She is a ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Baland va nozik gavda → raqqosa. 'dance' + er.
tasks.speak: 9  Mary is quite tall and slim. She is a ____ .

tasks.prompt: 10  Chinese people have usually got a ____ complexion.
tasks.whyUz: 'yellow' + -ish = sarg'ish. '-ish' rang nomiga qo'shilsa 'ozgina o'sha rangda' ma'nosini beradi.
tasks.speak: 10  Chinese people have usually got a ____ complexion.

exercises.explanationUz:
1–4-unitlarning lug'ati aralash:
  Unit 1 — kasblar, millatlar
  Unit 2 — tashqi ko'rinish (soch, ko'z, teri)
  Unit 3 — uy jihozlari
  Unit 4 — qarindoshlik, xarakter

Har bir bandda gapning MA'NOSIGA qarang.

tasks.prompt: 1  Beth isn't a very good student. She's very ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Yaxshi o'qimaslikning sababi — dangasalik. 'rude' (qo'pol) va 'clever' (aqlli) mos emas.

tasks.prompt: 2  Mr Cline works at the hospital. He is a(n) ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Kasalxonada — jarroh (surgeon). Muhandis va musiqachi kasalxonada ishlamaydi.

tasks.prompt: 3  Is Jane's hair grey? No, it's ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Soch RANGI so'ralgan. 'wavy' — shakl (to'lqinsimon), 'yellow' esa soch uchun ishlatilmaydi — 'fair' yoki 'blonde' deyiladi.

tasks.prompt: 4  There are two ____ in the bathroom.
tasks.whyUz: Hammomda oyna bo'ladi. Divan — mehmonxonada, plita — oshxonada.
Keyin OT ('magazine') keladi va javob egalik ('Karen's') → Whose.

tasks.prompt: 6  My sister goes to primary school. She's very ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Boshlang'ich maktab — 5–11 yosh → yosh (young).

tasks.prompt: 7  Kim is my sister's daughter. She's my ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Opa-singilning QIZI — niece (qiz jiyan). 'nephew' — o'g'il jiyan.
Shvetsiya — Shimoliy Yevropa → oq (och) teri. 'slanting eyes' — Sharqiy Osiyo, 'dark brown skin' — Afrika.

tasks.prompt: 9  There is a big ____ in the kitchen.
tasks.whyUz: Oshxonada 'sink' (idish yuviladigan joy). 'washbasin' — hammomda, 'bookcase' — ish xonasida.

tasks.prompt: 10  I like my teacher. She's always very ____ .
tasks.whyUz: 'I like my teacher' — ijobiy. Demak ijobiy sifat kerak: patient (sabrli).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing preposition. (8 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1–4-unitlardagi barcha predloglar aralash:

  OF   — 'the capital of', qism
  WITH — tashqi ko'rinish tavsifi
  FROM — kelib chiqish
  IN   — bino, xona ichida
  ON   — devor, yuza
  AT   — muassasa
  BEHIND — orqasida

Rasmda Praga — Chexiya poytaxti ko'rsatilgan.

tasks.prompt: 1  Prague is the capital ____ the Czech Republic.
tasks.whyUz: 'the capital OF' — turg'un birikma. Praga — Chexiya poytaxti.
tasks.speak: 1  Prague is the capital ____ the Czech Republic.

tasks.prompt: 2  He is well-built ____ short fair hair.
tasks.whyUz: Tashqi ko'rinish tavsifida WITH.
tasks.speak: 2  He is well-built ____ short fair hair.

tasks.whyUz: Kelib chiqish uchun FROM (Unit 1).

tasks.prompt: 4  John lives ____ a huge block of flats.
tasks.whyUz: Bino ICHIDA yashaydi → IN.
tasks.speak: 4  John lives ____ a huge block of flats.

tasks.prompt: 5  There is a lovely poster ____ the wall.
tasks.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsa uchun doim ON.
tasks.speak: 5  There is a lovely poster ____ the wall.

tasks.prompt: 6  Is there a fireplace ____ the living-room?
tasks.whyUz: Xona ichida → IN.
tasks.speak: 6  Is there a fireplace ____ the living-room?

tasks.prompt: 7  My father works ____ the local hospital.
tasks.whyUz: Muassasa bilan AT: work AT the hospital.
tasks.speak: 7  My father works ____ the local hospital.

tasks.whyUz: Bog' odatda uyning ORQASIDA. 'in front of' ham bo'lishi mumkin, lekin britan uylarida bog' orqada.

exercises.explanationUz:
TONI VILSONNING XATI — 26-betdagi Toni Filipsning xatiga
o'xshash, lekin oila a'zolari batafsilroq tasvirlangan.

Har bir odam uchun ikki xil ma'lumot:
  APPEARANCE — tashqi ko'rinishi
  CHARACTER  — xarakteri

Bu — 9-mashqdagi 10 ta savolga javob berish uchun kerak.

tasks.en: Dear Jane,
My name is Tony Wilson. I am thirteen years old and I live in Liverpool in England.
tasks.uz: Mening ismim Toni Vilson. Men o'n uch yoshdaman va Angliyadagi Liverpulda yashayman.
tasks.note: Liverpul — Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi shahar, Beatles guruhi vatani.

tasks.en: There are five of us in our family.
My father, John, is an artist.
He's a very clever person and he's very kind.
tasks.uz: U juda aqlli odam va juda mehribon.

tasks.en: My mother, Elaine, is very beautiful.
She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes.
tasks.uz: U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun, tekis va sariq, ko'zlari ko'k.
tasks.note: KO'RINISH. Uch sifat soch uchun: long + straight + fair.

tasks.en: She's a very patient woman.
My brother, Martin, is sixteen years old.
He is tall with brown hair and blue eyes.
tasks.uz: U baland bo'yli, sochi jigarrang, ko'zlari ko'k.

tasks.en: He's quite lazy.
tasks.note: XARAKTER: lazy. 'quite' = ancha — salbiy sifatni yumshatadi.

tasks.en: My sister, Karen, is fifteen years old.
She's short with green eyes.
She is a bit bossy.
tasks.note: XARAKTER: bossy. 'a bit' = biroz — muloyimlik uchun.

tasks.en: Well, that's all about me. Please write soon and tell me about your family.
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, men haqimda shuncha. Iltimos, tezroq yozing va oilangiz haqida gapirib bering.
tasks.note: Standart yakun. Ikki buyruq: write, tell.

tasks.en: Best wishes, Tony

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SAVOL — har biri 1 ball.

IKKI XIL SAVOLNI ADASHTIRMANG:
  'What does X look like?'      → TASHQI KO'RINISH
  'Can you describe X's character?' → XARAKTER

Javobni xatdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oling, lekin
OLMOSHNI o'zgartiring: 'I' → 'he', 'my mother' → 'his mother'.

tasks.en: He is thirteen years old.
tasks.note: Xatda: 'I am thirteen years old' → 'He is ...'.

tasks.en: He lives in Liverpool, in England.
tasks.note: Xatda: 'I live in Liverpool in England'. 'lives' — 3-shaxs -s.

tasks.en: He is an artist.
tasks.note: Xatda: 'My father, John, is an artist'.

tasks.en: He is very clever and very kind.
She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes. She is very beautiful.
She is a very patient woman.
He is tall with brown hair and blue eyes.
He is quite lazy.
She is short with green eyes.
She is a bit bossy.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs in brackets. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shaklini qo'ying. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH XIL FE'L aralash:

  'to be'    — am / is / are
  'have got' — have got / has got
  oddiy fe'l — Present Simple (-s, do/does, don't/doesn't)

HAR BIRIDA BOSHQA QOIDA:
  to be:      savol — fe'l oldinga chiqadi (Where IS Juan from?)
  have got:   savol — 'Has he got ...?', inkor — 'hasn't got'
  oddiy fe'l: savol — 'Does he live?', inkor — 'doesn't live'

'to be' va 'have got' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI!

tasks.whyUz: 'to be' savolda oldinga chiqadi: Where IS Juan from? 'does' KERAK EMAS.
he/she/it → is.
'like' oddiy fe'l → DO you like. 'like' dan keyin -ING (swimming).
'I' bilan don't. To'liq: 'No, I don't.'
3-shaxs birlik 'have got' inkori → hasn't got. 'doesn't have' ham bo'ladi.
3-shaxs birlik → has got.

tasks.prompt: 4: Helen usually ____ (watch) TV in the afternoons ...
tasks.whyUz: 3-shaxs birlik + -ch → watchES. 'usually' fe'ldan oldin.
tasks.speak: 4: Helen usually ____ (watch) TV in the afternoons ...

tasks.whyUz: Oddiy -s. 'listen TO' — 'to' shart.
'to be' → is.
is + not → isn't. 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.
3-shaxs birlik savoli → DOES Philip LIVE (fe'l -s siz).
3-shaxs birlik → does.

tasks.prompt: 7: My father ____ (not/get up) early on Saturdays.
tasks.whyUz: doesn't + asos shakl. 'on Saturdays' — har shanba.
tasks.speak: 7: My father ____ (not/get up) early on Saturdays.

tasks.whyUz: 'to be' oldinga chiqadi: IS it a big house?

tasks.prompt: 8 B: Yes, there ____ (be) eight rooms in it.
tasks.whyUz: 'There ARE' — ko'plik (Unit 3).
tasks.speak: 8 B: Yes, there ____ (be) eight rooms in it.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct word to fill in each gap. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir bo'shliqqa to'g'ri so'zni tanlang. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI: hers, my, she, him, his, her

Har biri FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Ro'yxatda uch xil olmosh bor:

  EGA olmoshi:      she
  OBYEKT olmoshi:   him
  EGALIK SIFATI:    my, his, her
  EGALIK OLMOSHI:   hers

QANDAY TANLASH:
  • fe'ldan oldin      → she
  • fe'l/predlogdan keyin → him
  • otdan oldin        → my, his, her
  • ot yo'q            → hers

tasks.promptUz: Keyin ot bor; savol AYOL haqida
tasks.whyUz: 'favourite sport' oti bor → EGALIK SIFATI. Savolda 'she' → her.

tasks.promptUz: Javob beruvchi o'z raqami haqida; keyin ot bor
tasks.whyUz: 'number' oti bor → egalik sifati. Javob beruvchi o'zi haqida → my.

tasks.promptUz: Keyin ot bor; savol ERKAK haqida
tasks.whyUz: 'favourite sport' oti bor → egalik sifati. Savolda 'he' → his.
Fe'l ('is') dan oldin → EGA shakli. Bet — ayol → she.
'to' predlogidan keyin → OBYEKT shakli. Dag — erkak → him.
Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → EGALIK OLMOSHI. Liza — ayol → hers.

exercises.explanationUz:
QARATQICH KELISHIGI — apostrof qayerga qo'yiladi?

  BIRLIK ot           → 's   (my son's car)
  KO'PLIK ot (-s bilan) → s'   (the girls' bags)
  Ikki egasi          → 's faqat OXIRGISIGA

QANDAY BILISH: gapdagi BOSHQA so'zlarga qarang —
fe'l va son bir yoki ko'pligini ko'rsatadi:
  'My son's car IS red'    — bitta mashina, bitta o'g'il
  'These ARE the girls' bags' — ko'p qiz, ko'p sumka

tasks.whyUz: 'car IS red' — bitta mashina, bitta o'g'il → BIRLIK → 's.
Bitta amma, ikki jiyan → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga.
'These ARE ... bagS' — ko'p sumka, ko'p qiz → KO'PLIK → s'.
'name IS Kate' — BITTA ism, bitta qiz → 's.

tasks.prompt: 5  Our ____ study is in the attic.
tasks.whyUz: Har kimning bitta otasi bor va 'study IS' — birlik → 's.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers, as in the example. (7 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
Yetti shaxsiy savol va ularning javoblari.

JAVOB SHAKLIDAN SAVOLNI TOPING:
  raqam (yosh)      → How old are you?
  Yes/No            → Are you from London?
  kasb              → What's your job?
  ism va familiya   → What's your name?
  harflar           → Can you spell it, please?
  uy manzili        → What's your home address?
  telefon raqami    → What's your phone number?

DIQQAT — ikki xil raqam:
  'I'm 28 years old'  — YOSH
  '8695980'           — TELEFON (raqamma-raqam o'qiladi)

tasks.right: f  No, I'm not. I'm from Manchester.
b  Yes, of course. P-E-T-E-R ... J-O-N-E-S

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir qatorda TO'RT so'z bor. Uchtasi bir guruhga tegishli,
BITTASI esa boshqa guruhdan — o'shani toping.

O'ng tomonda o'sha guruh nomi yozilgan (man, hair, eyes...).
Savol: qaysi so'z shu ot bilan ISHLATILMAYDI?

NAMUNA (kitobda aylantirilgan):
  1  tall, short, OLD, well-built — man
  'tall, short, well-built' — GAVDA tavsifi.
  'old' — YOSH tavsifi. Demak ortiqcha so'z: old.

tasks.whyUz: young/middle-aged/old — YOSH. 'dark' — soch yoki teri RANGI.
brown/grey/pale — RANG. 'wavy' — soch SHAKLI (to'lqinsimon).
wavy/curly/straight — soch SHAKLI. 'slanting' — faqat KO'Z uchun (qiyiq ko'z).
slanting/blue/brown — KO'Z tavsifi. 'slim' — GAVDA (nozik).
pale/dark/light — TERI rangi. 'wide' — kenglik (masalan 'wide eyes').
beautiful/pretty/gorgeous — KO'RINISH. 'patient' — XARAKTER (sabrli).

tasks.prompt: 8  lazy, kind, bossy, rude, curly — woman
tasks.whyUz: lazy/kind/bossy/rude — XARAKTER. 'curly' — SOCH shakli.

exercises.instructionEn: Describe a member of your family. Talk about his/her physical appearance and character. Use words from Exs. 9 and 10. (18 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Oila a'zolaringizdan birini tasvirlab bering. Uning tashqi ko'rinishi va xarakteri haqida gapiring. 9 va 10-mashqlardagi so'zlardan foydalaning. (18 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
ENG KO'P BALL BERADIGAN MASHQ — 18 ball.

TUZILISHI (9-mashqdagi xat kabi):
  1) Kim ekanini ayting: This is my ... His/Her name is ...
  2) Yoshi: He/She is ... years old.
  3) TASHQI KO'RINISH: bo'y, gavda, soch, ko'z
  4) XARAKTER: 2–3 ta sifat
  5) Fikringiz: I like him/her because ...

KERAKLI SO'ZLAR (9 va 10-mashqlardan):
  GAVDA:   tall, short, slim, well-built
  YOSH:    young, middle-aged, old
  SOCH:    long/short, straight/wavy/curly, fair/dark/brown/grey
  KO'Z:    blue, green, brown, slanting
  TERI:    pale, dark, light complexion
  KO'RINISH: beautiful, pretty, gorgeous, good-looking, handsome
  XARAKTER: kind, patient, clever, friendly, generous,
            lazy, bossy, rude, aggressive

BALL OSHIRISH USULLARI:
  • 'quite' va 'a bit' bilan yumshating
  • 'because' bilan sabab ayting
  • ijobiy va salbiy sifatni 'but' bilan bog'lang

tasks.en: This is my sister. Her name is Malika.
She is fifteen years old.
She is quite tall and slim.
She has got long straight dark hair.
She has got brown eyes and a light complexion.
She is very pretty.
She is kind, clever and very friendly.
She is a bit bossy, though.
I like her a lot because she always helps me.
This is my sister. Her name is Malika and she is fifteen years old.
She is quite tall and slim. She has got long straight dark hair, brown eyes and a light complexion. She is very pretty.
Malika is kind, clever and very friendly. She is a bit bossy, though.
I like her a lot because she always helps me with my homework.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Millat nomi HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi.
Rangga -ish qo'shilsa, 'ozgina o'sha rangda' ma'nosini beradi.

items.derived: Hope to hear from you soon.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Odamning bo'yi va tanasi haqida. 'man/woman' bilan ishlatiladi.
Uch xil xususiyat. Gapda TARTIBI: uzunlik → shakl → rang.
Ko'z rangi va shakli, teri rangi.
Salbiy sifatni muloyimroq qiladi — bu ingliz madaniyatida muhim.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the capital OF + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'the capital OF' — turg'un birikma, boshqa predlog ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where is + ISM + from? — He/She is from + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is Juan from? — He is from Spain.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to be' fe'li savolda OLDINGA chiqadi — 'does' kerak emas.
'from' gap oxirida qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do/Does + ega + fe'l + ...? — Yes, ... do/does. / No, ... don't/doesn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does Philip live in Madrid? — Yes, he does.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan do/does kerak. Fe'l -s olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody hasn't got + ... . He/She has got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny hasn't got curly hair. She has got straight hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jennining sochi jingalak emas. Uning sochi tekis.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI — 'has' o'zi inkorni oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + sifat, BUT Y isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My English teacher is very patient, but my Maths teacher isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ingliz tili o'qituvchim juda sabrli, lekin matematika o'qituvchim yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi qismda sifat TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat 'isn't' qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is it a + sifat + ot? — Yes, there are + son + rooms in it.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is it a big house? — Yes, there are eight rooms in it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu katta uymi? — Ha, unda sakkizta xona bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes, it's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. / Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yes, it's her favourite sport. Yes, it's hers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ha, bu uning sevimli sporti. Ha, u uniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ot bo'lsa — sifat, ot bo'lmasa — olmosh.
'to' predlogidan keyin obyekt shakli (him, her, them, me).

sentencePatterns.formula: How old is X? — He/She is + son + years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old is Tony? — He is thirteen years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni necha yoshda? — U o'n uch yoshda.

sentencePatterns.formula: What does X look like? — He/She is + gavda + WITH + soch va ko'z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does his mother look like? — She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Onasi qanday ko'rinadi? — U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun, tekis va sariq, ko'zlari ko'k.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASHQI KO'RINISH savoli. Soch tartibi: uzunlik → shakl → rang.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can you describe X's character? — He/She is + xarakter sifatlari.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you describe his father's character? — He is very clever and very kind.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otasining xarakterini tasvirlab bera olasizmi? — U juda aqlli va juda mehribon.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She is + ijobiy sifatlar. He/She is a bit + salbiy sifat, though.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is kind, clever and very friendly. She is a bit bossy, though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mehribon, aqlli va juda do'stona. Biroz buyruqboz esa.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval ijobiy, keyin salbiy — muloyimlik qoidasi.
'a bit' va 'though' yumshatadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like her a lot because she always helps me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni juda yoqtiraman, chunki u doim menga yordam beradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'because' bilan sabab aytish — yozma ishda ball oshiradi.
